split_question: Should refugees be made to repay the cost of the support they received while their asylum claim was decided, if they can afford to?
angles: repay only if they can afford it, with a fixed cap
no charge: support is the cost of running a fair asylum system
pay by a different route, such as tax once they work
facts_for_writers: The Refugee Council was asking supporters to back amendments that would remove the £10,000 charge on refugees who receive asylum support while their claim is considered. (s1)
The Bill was due back in the Commons for report stage on 18 November 2026. (s1)
The government says the Bill includes a new mechanism to require asylum seekers in taxpayer-funded accommodation to contribute to costs when they can afford to. (s2)
The government says the Bill aims to speed up asylum decisions and close loopholes. (s2)
